Every one of the ten figures prints "Fig N" without a period or colon, which is outside the numbering vocabulary and therefore recorded as none; the tables print "Table N". Figure captions sit below the art and table captions above the grid, with the single exception that Table 1’s caption is a separate centred line above its grid rather than a header cell. There are ten tables, one of them (Table 4) carried across the page 7 to 8 break and counted once, and the appendix reuses the number 8 for a second Collection data table. Figure 9 is printed as three separately measured panels in one row under a single caption, so it contributes three rows. Eight of the ten figures are cited at least once by printed number (Figs 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10, Fig 8 twice); Fig 3 is only pointed at with "as follows:" and Fig 7 is never referred to in the text at all. Fig 8 reuses Fig 2 in both senses - the same MATLAB artwork with recoloured curves and the same caption wording - and the numbering is loose in the two usual directions: Fig 1 is cited on page 9 with its art three pages earlier, and the appendix spends the table number 8 a second time.
rules: 图号统一写成 "Fig N"，数字后既不带句点也不带冒号（Table 1 assumptions、Fig 3 ICNP model’s prediction process 都是如此），因此十张图全部落在编号词表之外，一律记 [caption.numbering]=none，表则记 "Table N" [caption.numbering]。
题注位置：十张图与三张表的题注都在图形下方，十张表都在网格上方；Fig 1 的题注排成正文段落而不是粗体标题，Table 1 的题注 "Table 1 assumptions" 是网格上方单独居中的一行，不是表格首行 [caption.position]。
Fig 9 的三个面板在图面上各自独立测量、共用一个题注：题注只记在位置最左的 p19r3 上，另外两个面板 [caption_source]=none；三次引用（p20 的 "According to fig 9"）合并成一条，记在最左面板的 [mention] 上，另外两个面板的 [mention.count]=0。
Table 4 跨页：只在 p7r1 计数一次并记 [table.continued]=true，p8r1 的续行按 split-across-pages 排除；续页不重复表头，两条 Notes 圆点行仍属同一张表 [table.note_sentence]。
附录两张表都把编号印成 "Table 8"/"Table 9" 而标题都是 Collection data，即 8 号被用了两次（p21 的 strengths and weaknesses 也是 8 号）；两张表各自按实测区域独立记一行，不合并、不改号 [caption.verbatim]。
Fig 9 的题注与 Table 7 的正文都把参数写成 "β"、"table 7" 这样的小写形式，引用样式一律照录原稿拼写（"fig 9"、"fig5" 无空格、"fig 2"），不做规范化 [mention.style]。
